Commentary.Commentary: It was a disappointing ODI series for the hosts. Can they win this T20I here? They have got a good total on the board. Let's see what do we have in store then. Join us back in a bit for the run chase!

Unadkat and Dhawan went over 40 runs in their 4-over spell. Chahal wasn't that impressive too actually as he gave away 38 runs. Dhawan and Chahal managed to pick up a wicket each though. Bumrah was pretty good as he gave just 24 runs and grabbed two wickets. Axar Patel was miserly with the ball as he gave 18 runs only from his spell and took a wicket as well.

Superb finish by Zimbabwe here. They smashed 70 runs off the last 6 overs. Greame Cremer at the toss mentioned he was looking around 160-170 and his batters didn't disappoint. Chibhabha and Masakadza got the hosts off to a positive start earlier but could not make their starts count. Later on Malcolm Waller took on the charge and played a good cameo of 30 runs. The Indian bowlers were taken for runs towards the end as Elton Chigumbura sensation fifty took them to 170.
Banged in short on off, Chigumbura ducks under it to let it go through. ZIMBABWE FINISH ON 170/6!
Third T20I fifty for Elton Chigumbura!
SIX! FIFTY FOR CHIGUMBURA! Sensational knock by the veteran! Short of a length ball on off, Chigumbura pulls it over the mid-wicket region for a biggie to bring up his fifty. Well played, Elton!
Landed outside off, Madziva guides it to third man for a single.
The ball strikes the batsman very low on the pads One run added to the total. Leg byes given by the umpire.
SIX! That's a fabulous shot! Low full toss on off, Chigumbura lofts it superbly over the long off region for a biggie.
Tad short on off, Madziva comes forward and plays it awkwardly to point for a quick single.
Fuller length ball outside off, Chigumbura comes down the track to go after this one but misses. End of Unadkat's spell, 4-0-43-0.
SIX! ANOTHER BIGGIE! Length ball on off, Chigumbura picks it early again and smokes it over the long on region for a maximum. He moves to 42 now off just 21 balls.
WIDE! Unadkat is under big pressure here. He's looking really nervous against Chigumbura. Bowls yet another wide ball outside off.
WIDE! Full and way outside off, Chigumbura leaves it alone. Wide signaled.
Slower one outside off, Chigumbura waits for it and punches it through extra cover for a couple.
SIX! Chigumbura is in some mood today! Around off, in the slot, Chigumbura clears his front leg and deposits it over long on for a biggie. That's gone over the roof! New ball please.
FOUR! Switching the angle doesn't help the seamer! Fullish ball outside off, Chigumbura goes after it but gets a top edge towards third man for a boundary.
Unadkat comes round the wicket...
Landed outside off, angling across, Madziva comes down the track but mistimes it over point for a single.
Unadkat back on.
The batsman has played it towards square leg. They pick up a single.
Full ball on off, Chigumbura drives it towards mid off for a run.
Slower one around off, Madziva tries to play it across but the ball goes off the inside edge to the on side. Single taken.
Fuller length ball outside off, Chigumbura drives it through mid off for a single.
Good length ball outside off, Chigumbura defends it into the ground.
NEVILLE MADZIVA walks in next.

OUT! Straight to the fielder! Back of a length ball outside off, Cremer tries to loft it over mid off as the fielder is inside the circle but he doesn't time it well. The ball goes straight to Rishi Dhawan at mid off who takes another catch. Bumrah gets his second, the Zimbabwean captain departs.
Bumrah returns.
On middle and leg, Chigumbura comes down the track to play but misses and gets hit on the pads.
SIX! Amazing batting by Chigumbura! He's on fire! Outside off, Chigumbura comes down the track and smacks it over wide long off for another biggie.
Loopy outside off, driven through mid off for a single.
Around off, flicked away to the leg side for a single.
SIX! Superb shot! Fullish ball outside off, Chigumbura lofts it over the extra cover region for a biggie. The leggie is taken for runs here.
Landed around off, Cremer lofts it over the mid off region for a single.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Outside off, Cremer guides it to third man for a single.
Full on off, Chigumbura flicks it through mid-wicket for a single.
Landed outside off, Cremer drives it through covers for a couple.
Full on off, Chigumbura flicks it through mid-wicket for a single.
GRAEME CREMER is the next man in.

OUT! Mutombodzi holes out! Tossed up ball outside off, Mutombodzi looks to clear long off but doesn't clear enough distance. The ball goes towards Rishi Dhawan at long off who makes no mistake. Not the best of shots by Mutombodzi there.
Around off, Chigumbura comes down the track and blocks.
SIX! Best way to make use of the Free Hit! Fullish ball outside off, Chigumbura lofts it over the extra cover region. The ball goes all the way for a biggie.
Free Hit coming up...
NO BALL! Oh dear, Chahal has overstepped. On middle and leg, Mutombodzi flicks it through mid-wicket for a single. The umpire signals a no ball as well.
Yet another leg bye! On middle and leg, Chigumbura tries to play but the ball goes off the pads to mid-wicket.
Landed outside off, Mutombodzi looks to push but the ball goes off the pads. The batsmen take another leg bye.
Full ball on off, Mutombodzi drives it to the cover fielder.
Tossed up on off, Chigumbura tries to play it across but the ball goes off the pads towards mid-wicket. The batsmen take a leg bye.
Tossed up ball outside off, Chigumbura drives it through covers for a single to end the over.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Full on off, Chigumbura drives it back to the bowler.
On middle and off, Mutombodzi tucks it through mid-wicket for a single.
Landed around off, Mutombodzi flicks it to the mid-wicket region.
ELTON CHIGUMBURA walks out to bat.

OUT! RAZA IS RUN OUT! Landed outside off, Mutombodzi pushes it to the cover region. Bit of a mix-up between the two batsmen and in the end Raza is sent back. Pandey throws the ball at the non-striker's end where Patel whips off the bails to run out the batsman.
Axar Patel back on.
On middle and off, Raza pushes it back to the bowler. Successful over for India!
Full on off, Mutombodzi drives it through mid on for a single to get off the mark straightaway.
TINOTENDA MUTOMBODZI walks in next.

OUT! WALLER DEPARTS! The googly does the trick this time! Waller was batting really well but failed to read this one. Landed just outside off, Waller tries to steer but misses. The ball goes through and disturbs the off stump. Chahal gets his first wicket. Waller's promising looking knock comes to an end.
Full ball around off, Raza drills it to long on for a single.
Around off, Waller taps it to the off side for a quick single.
FOUR! This is superb batting! Fuller in length outside off, Waller bends his knee and lofts it over the cover region for a boundary.
Full ball on off, Raza digs it out into the ground. Dhawan ends his spell, 4-0-42-1.
Short of a length ball outside off, Waller pulls it through square leg for a single.

FOUR! Just past the fielder! Fuller length ball outside off, Waller tries to loft but doesn't time it that well. The ball just beats the backward point fielder and goes past the fence. Waller won't mind that.
Slower one on the pads, Waller tries to flick but the ball brushes off his pads and goes to the keeper behind.
WIDE! Full and down the leg side, Waller tries to clip but misses. The umpire signals a wide.
FOUR! Good batting! Tad short outside off, Waller waits for it and cuts it over the point region for a boundary.
Around off, Raza flicks it through mid-wicket for a single.
Rishi Dhawan back on.

Poor fielding! Fullish outside off, Waller pushes it to the point region and the non-striker says "NO" as the ball goes straight to the fielder but Axar Patel fielding there misfields and concedes a couple. The southpaw apologizes.
Outside off, Waller steers it to the third man region and takes a couple.
The batsman rocks onto the back foot and punches the ball to long on. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Googly outside off, Waller pushes it to cover-point for a quick single.
Landed outside off, Raza waits for it and hits it firmly through the cover region for a single.
Fullish outside off, Waller lofts it towards long off. There is some protection and the batsmen take a single.
Time for spin! YUZVENDRA CHAHAL into the attack.
On middle and leg, Waller flicks it through mid-wicket for a single.
Way too short now outside off, Waller gives himself some room and smashes it over the cover region for a couple.
Shortish around off now, the batsman tries to cut but gets a bottom edge almost onto his stumps.
Slightly short outside off, Raza steers it towards the backward point region for a single.
Shortish again outside off, Raza punches it straight to the cover fielder.
Shortish on off, Waller goes onto his back foot and punches it through covers for a single.
FOUR! Short of a length ball around off, Raza pulls it through the mid-wicket region. The ball wins the race and goes past the fence. Poor ball, that.
Tad short outside off, Waller punches it through covers for a single.

Angles it down the leg side, Waller tries to flick but the ball goes off the thigh pad. Stifled appeal for a caught behind but the umpire says no. Not an ideal line though if the fine leg is inside the circle.
Landed around off, Raza flicks it through mid-wicket for a single.
Length ball around off, Raza defends it from within his crease.
FOUR! That's a really good shot! Good length ball outside off, Raza pushes it through the point region and just beats the fielder there. The ball races away to the rope and Raza gets a boundary.
Outside off, Waller pushes it to the cover fielder.
Full outside off, driven through covers for a single.
Landed outside off, Waller pushes it through the cover region for a single.
Tossed up on off, Waller gets onto his front foot and defends.

FOUR! CHANCE MISSED! Shortish outside off, Waller tries to steer but the ball goes off the outside edge through the slip region. The ball falls just short of KL Rahul and goes through towards third man for a boundary.
Punched off the back foot by the batsman. The batsmen have run through for a single.
MALCOLM WALLER walks in next.

OUT! Slower one does the trick! Dhawan keeps stump-to-stump line here and bowls the slower one at 101.6 kph, Chibhabha goes for the slog over the leg side but misses it completely. The ball crashes onto the stumps and Zimbabwe lose another wicket.
Fuller length ball outside off, driven through point for a couple.
FOUR! Well played! Landed outside off, Chibhabha comes down the track and smashes it through the extra cover region for a boundary.

RUN OUT CHANCE MISSED! Outside off, Raza taps it to cover point. Axar Patel collects the ball and misses his shy at the non-striker's end. Had there been a direct hit, Chibhabha would have been a goner as he was trying to make it back and he was nowhere in the frame. No backup there and the batsmen take a single off the overthrow.
Over-pitched outside off, driven to wide mid off for another single.
Fuller length ball outside off, Raza pushes it to wide mid off for a quick single.
Rishi Dhawan back on.
FOUR! Superb shot! Length ball outside off, in the slot, Chibhabha lofts it over the mid off region for a boundary to end the Powerplay.
Fullish ball outside off, Raza taps it to mid off for a single.
Outside off, Chibhabha comes down the track and plays it towards mid off for a single.
The batsman works it down the leg side. They pick up a single.
The physio is out in the middle to treat Mutumbami. He's been taken off the field as he's unable to walk properly. Hope he's fine. SIKANDAR RAZA is the next man in.

OUCH! That must have hurt! Good length ball on off, Mutumbami tries to play it across but misses and gets hit on his stomach. He looks in some pain as he lies down on the ground. Mutumbami was early onto his shot there.
Landed around off, Chibhabha works it through mid-wicket for a single.
Landed around off, Mutumbami covers the line and defends. Wicket maiden by Bumrah!

Appeal for an LBW! Angles it down the leg side, Mutumbami tries to clip but misses. Dhoni collects the ball and appeals for a catch but the umpire says no. Replays show it went off the thigh pad and it's a good decision by the umpire.
Length ball outside off, Mutumbami tries to steer but fails to put his bat on the ball.
RICHMOND MUTUMBAMI walks out next.

OUT! BUMRAH STRIKES! Slower ball around the off stump line, Masakadza tries to scoop it over the short fine leg region but doesn't time it well. The ball goes high up in the air and Dhoni goes to his left to get under the ball and completes a safe catch. Masakadza's nice cameo comes to an end.
Good length ball on off, Masakadza pushes it to mid on again. This one goes just past the bowler.
Tad full around off, Masakadza pushes it towards mid on.
Play and a miss! Good length ball on middle and off, Chibhabha comes down the track and goes for a big shot but misses it completely.
Good length ball around off, Chibhabha pushes it back to the bowler.
Outside off, Masakadza guides it towards third man for a single.

SIX! Smart batting by Masakadza there! He's giving respect to the good balls but anything short, then he's going after it. Unadkat pitches it short and pays the price as the Zimbabwean opener pulls it over the backward square leg region for another biggie.
Length ball on middle and off, Masakadza defends it from within his crease.

SIX! Sensational shot! Fuller length ball around the off stump line, slower in pace, Masakadza picks it early and smokes it over wide long on. The ball goes high up in the air but clears the distance.
Change of ends for Unadkat.
Full toss outside off, Masakadza pushes it through the extra cover region. The fielder puts in a dive to stop the ball. Just a single taken to end the over.
Good length ball on off, Chamu tucks it to wide mid on for a single.
Full ball outside off, Chibhabha plays it towards cover-point. Masakadza wants a run but he's sent back.
Fuller length ball outside off, driven towards extra cover by Chibhabha.
FOUR! Fine shot! Good length ball on off, Chibhabha comes forward and lofts it over the mid on region for a boundary. Both these openers are looking dangerous here.
Landed around off, Chibhabha stays back in his crease and defends.
JASPRIT BUMRAH into the attack, replacing Unadkat.
FOUR! That's a lovely shot! Landed outside off, Masakadza leans onto it and drives it superbly through the cover region. The ball goes through the gap and races away to the fence.
Length ball on off, Chibhabha tries to heave but the ball goes off the inside half of the bat and towards deep square leg. Single taken.
Slower one outside off, fuller in length, Masakadza tucks it towards mid-wicket for a single.
Tad short outside off, Masakadza punches it to the off side.
SIX! Take that! Short of a length ball outside off, Masakadza pulls it confidently over the mid-wicket region. The ball goes all the way for a biggie. What a way to get off the mark!
Around off, Masakadza flicks it towards mid-wicket.
RISHI DHAWAN to bowl from the other end.
That's an interesting shot! On the pads, Masakadza tries to sweep but loses his balance completely. The ball goes off his forearm towards short fine leg and the batsmen take a leg bye.
Tad short on middle and leg, Masakadza tucks it to the on side.

On middle and leg, Chibhabha tucks it to square leg and sets off. Chahal collects the ball and throws it at the striker's end but misses his shy. Had there been a direct hit, it would have been really close. Risky run taken to get off the mark.
Fuller length ball around off, shapes in after landing, Chibhabha drives it firmly but straight to mid on.
Good length ball around the off stump line, Chibhabha goes back in his crease and defends.
Starts off with a full ball on off, almost a yorker, Chibhabha digs it out to the off side.
The players are out in the middle. HAMILTON MASAKADZA and CHAMU CHIBHABHA are the Zimbabwe openers. JAYDEV UNADKAT to bowl first up. Here we go!
Graeme Cremer says he would have bowled first too. Adds they are looking to post around 160-170. He thinks Zimbabwe have got players who can step up and make their mark.

MS Dhoni says he is looking to bowl first. Adds they have five debutants (Rishi Dhawan, Mandeep Singh, Jaydev Unadkat, KL Rahul, Yuzvendra Chahal) today. He thinks these players have some experience in the domestic circuit and he's happy they are getting an international exposure here. Adds 140-150 can be achieved on this wicket.
INDIA WIN THE TOSS AND ELECT TO FIELD!
Pitch report - There are some cracks but they are not wide enough. There are some dark patches but those patches are not enough too. It's a bat first wicket.

Hello everyone to the coverage of the first T20I between Zimbabwe and India at the Harare Sports Club. The visitors thrashed Zimbabwe 3-0 in the ODI series and now would be looking to do the same in this shortest format of the game. Zimbabwe have suffered some injuries as well and it won't help them at all. Let's see what do we have in store today. You can't take anyone lightly in this format though. India have some exciting T20 players who have played well recently in the T20 league. Let's hope for a close game at least!
